🔴 *triage-bot catch-up — CRON STALL ~4 DAYS* (06-24 14:12Z)

Last successful poll cycle: *2026-06-20 11:22Z* (itself a manual catch-up). No automated cycle since — the hourly cron has not fired in ~4 days. This is the 3rd stall in a week (prior: 06-19 22:18Z, 06-20). Triage was effectively offline for production alerting this whole window.

*Current production state: CALM — no active incident.*
• #swat empty. #team-incident-response = automated SWAT-runbook posts only (06-22; journalagent.service stopped cleanly on MSL04 — DEVOPS warning, informational). No human incident.
• DD monitors: no service error-rate/latency monitor firing (all "firing" = chronic No-Data synthetics + infra, last-triggered months ago).
• DD prod error logs last 3h: 0.
• ES Error level last 6h: 380, all chronic signatures (timezone-id 'America/New_York' 44x, Rainforest payment business-logic 60x, QBO merchant DNS 16x, QBO TimeActivity 16x, task-canceled 8x). No spike, no new exception, no cascade.
• Tools: gh/dd/es ok; sql/mongo skipped (no SSH this run).

*Backlog while blind* (~418+ empty-body block alerts, ~4 days): alert-system ~101, alert-frontend-errors ~105, alert-runtime-monitoring >=210, team-incident-response 12, swat 0. DD/ES confirm these were point-in-time chronic alerts that self-recovered (map to ki-2026-05-21 gateway-timeout + ki-2026-05-24 runtime-core p95). Deferred per-alert replay — it'd be 400+ "suppressed known-issue" no-ops with no signal.

*Action needed:* investigate why the cron isn't firing / add a watchdog that pages when no poll-cycle line is written in >2h. The heartbeat flagged "degraded" twice but never hard-escalated past a day.
Report: docs/investigations/2026-06-24-poll-catchup.md
